item.title: About
item.description:
I’m a Software Engineer at Goldman Sachs in New York, working within Global Banking & Markets on trade data and have experience building client onboarding systems.

My recent work includes rebuilding a risk ranking system used in client onboarding — applying configurable business rules to assess and classify clients across multiple dimensions. I also served as the regional SME for my team in New York, acting as the primary technical point of contact across a globally distributed team.
